steers.title: Trade cluster: DOT + SUPER
steers.detail: Both opened within 1 minutes. Correlation risk.

deep_analysis:
Both open trades are LONG, opened 10:49/10:50 UTC (0.45h), both at ~breakeven — no profit-lock or staleness trigger fires this cycle (max age 0.45h vs 8h flag; no position +2%). The question is whether either thesis still holds.

SUPER LONG (bb-squeeze+, signal meta_rsi 70.4, lev 3, SL 0.17596 = -0.91%, TP 0.18024 = +1.50%): the squeeze thesis needed volume expansion and BTC holding the reclaimed EMA300. Neither is there — 1m RSI has already cooled 70.4 → 55.8, BTC slipped from ABOVE back to AT continuum EMA300 at 11:18 (price 79874 vs EMA 79804, dur 66 ticks) after only ~33m above, volume_regime LOW, acceleration NEGATIVE. Would I open this fresh now? No — the momentum half of the setup is gone and the entry sat 1.6 pts under the LONG band ceiling (72). SL at -0.91% is roughly 1x 1h range (SUPER ATR 1.86%), i.e. reachable on noise, so the choice is an early thesis exit or riding to hard SL; the 85.2% chop-bleed cohort says the expensive version is waiting for -0.91% on a never-armed entry.

DOT LONG (r2v2-long3, signal meta_rsi 58.3, lev 5, SL 0.98018 = -0.85%, TP 1.00402 = +1.57%): signal-time RSI sits inside LONG 55-64, this week's weakest long band (7d n=23, 34.8% WR, -$0.75; 8/23 vs chance is NOT significant, p~0.11 — directional only, advisory, re-measure due today by brain_auditor). Live RSI has faded to 46.6. r2v2-long3 itself is flat-negative (14d n=16, 62.5% WR, -$0.03). DOT 30d: 13T, 61.5% WR, -$0.08 — decent hit rate, bad payoff, i.e. exits are the issue on this coin, not entries.

Regime check on both: aligned on the 15m source (btc_15m LONG_BIAS, aggregate LONG_BIAS 98L/2S/29N), but BTC's own tape is a chop pin (continuum AT, auto_trader regime CHOP, vol LOW, velocity SLOW, acceleration NEGATIVE). Sources disagree and must be named: 15m scanner says LONG_BIAS, continuum says AT pin, auto-trader says CHOP. Flips/24h: aggregate 21, BTC 25 (p50 19-20, p95 26) — standing churn, not an anomaly, not the rare <6 trend tape. No direction-flavored steer is enforceable while BTC sits on the pin.

Exposure: 2/2 long, opened in the same 80s (automated steer-001 cluster is valid). One BTC leg down hits both; no offsetting short. Auto-trader shadow history is a warning on long-side chop: longs 0/9 (-$0.19), shorts 4/9 (+$0.115), all CHOP-regime.

AI trader: NO PICK this cycle. 8 candidates prechecked — all 6 LONGs fail the BTC gate (continuum ema300=AT = chop, not ABOVE → LONG-side BTC gate blocks in NEUTRAL 4h) plus RR/losers failures (ONDO/MET R:R grade D, SUSHI/ENA RR hard block, MET PENALTY, SUSHI LOSERS_LONG); both SHORTs fail the RSI band (FOGO 26.9 knife, ZORA 40.3 waiver-lapsed). AI_TRADER_ENABLED=False anyway, so any pick would be watchlist-only. Last pick BABY SHORT 05:51 UTC still standing, not rejected.
